themetoggle-desc: Waxay u oggolaanaysaa bogga inuu abuuro mawduucyo maxalli ah. Waxaa loo habeeyey habaynada leh kaydin xooggan, halkaas oo xal ku salaysan buskud uu khalkhal gelin karo kaydka.
themetoggle-prefs-theme-desc: Dooro mawduuca lagu soo bandhigayo wiki-gan:
themetoggle-simple-switch: Mawduuca hadda jira waa "$1". Taabo si aad u beddesho.
themetoggle-dropdown-switch: Fidi si aad u doorato mawduuc.
themetoggle-css-pages-list-intro: Bogagga CSS ee soo socda ayaa la tixraacayaa:
themetoggle-bundled-list-intro: Mawduucyada soo socda ma laha xaashiyo qaabayn gaar ah sababtoo ah waxaa lagu calaamadeeyey inay ku jiraan xidhmo:
themeusage-noresults: Lama helin isticmaalayaal leh dookhyo mawduuc aan ahayn kan caadiga ah.
themeusage-unknown-theme-tip: Isticmaalayaashan waxay dookhooda ku leeyihiin mawduuc aan la garanayn, taas oo laga yaabo inay sabab u tahay in mawduuca markii dambe la tirtiray. Waxay arki doonaan mawduuca caadiga ah halkii.
theme-auto-preference-description: Si toos ah (raac dookhyada nidaamka si loo go'aamiyo in la isticmaalo mawduuca iftiinka ama mugdiga)
